composer.placeholder: Type a command or tap the microphone…
composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line

chat.emptyHint: Ask me to research something, organise files, launch an app or do things on screen. By voice — press {{hotkey}} or say “Vivi”.
suggestions: What's new in my workspace folder?
Search the web for the latest Electron news
Take a screenshot and describe what's on screen
Create a notes file for today
chat.mockBanner: Mock agent mode: Claude is not connected. Open Settings → Account.

permission.title: Allow this action?
permission.dangerous: Dangerous command — review it before approving
permission.inputHint: Vivi will move the mouse and type. Keep your hands off the keyboard; to stop immediately press {{hotkey}} or move the cursor into a screen corner.

agent.bypassWarning: In this mode Vivi performs any action without confirmation. Use only if you fully trust the tasks.
agent.workspaceHint: Vivi keeps memory, notes and outputs here. Empty — ~/Vivi.
agent.customInstructionsHint: For example: “be concise”, “my main project is …”
agent.backendHint: The Agent SDK runs inside Vivi. ACP (Agent Client Protocol) runs Claude Code as a separate ACP agent — the same protocol Zed, JetBrains and other editors use; any other ACP agent can be plugged in too.
agent.acpCommandHint: Empty — the bundled Claude adapter (claude-agent-acp). Point it at another ACP agent instead, e.g. gemini or codex-acp.
agent.acpArgsHint: Extra arguments for the agent (quotes are supported).
agent.acpNote: Over ACP, Vivi hands the agent its own tools (screen, mouse, keyboard, windows, clipboard) through a local MCP server; authentication and proxy settings are shared with the built-in mode.

about.notice: Vivi is a personal assistant for your own use. Signing in with a Claude subscription is meant only for personal use with your own subscription and is not a way to distribute the product; for anything else use an API key.

permissionsUi.categoriesHint: What Vivi does without asking and what needs your confirmation.
permissionsUi.readOnlyHint: Reading files, search, web, screenshots, window list, clipboard
permissionsUi.askForExec: Ask before running commands and launching apps
permissionsUi.askForInput: Ask before controlling mouse and keyboard
permissionsUi.askForSystem: Ask before system actions (volume, lock, sleep)
permissionsUi.dangerNote: Dangerous commands (deleting folders, sudo, shutdown, force push) always require confirmation regardless of these switches.
permissionsUi.rulesHint: Rules added with the “Always allow” button. Remove a rule to be asked again.

errors.authentication_failed: Authentication failed. Check your account in Settings.
errors.rate_limit: Usage limit reached. Try again later.
errors.billing_error: There is a billing problem with the account.
errors.process_exited: The Claude Code process exited unexpectedly.
errors.max_turns: Step limit for this turn reached.
errors.max_budget: Cost limit for this turn reached.

account.notice: Signing in with a Claude subscription is for personal use with your own subscription only (it is not a way to distribute the app). For anything else use an Anthropic API key.
account.security: Secrets are stored encrypted in the OS keychain (Keychain / DPAPI / Secret Service).

claude.desc: A browser window opens to sign in to your Claude account (Pro/Max). After signing in, paste the confirmation code here.
claude.useExisting: Use the Claude Code sign-in on this computer
claude.pasteCode: The sign-in page is open in your browser. Copy the code and paste it here.

token.desc: Run the command below in a terminal (requires Claude Code and a subscription), copy the token and paste it here.

apikey.desc: Pay per token via the Anthropic Console. Create a key at:

onboarding.welcomeHint: A personal assistant powered by Claude: text and voice commands, files, the web, your apps. A few setup steps and you're ready.
onboarding.permissionsHint: To hear you and see the screen Vivi needs OS permissions. You can grant them later in system settings.
onboarding.voiceHint: Voice models run offline. Download speech recognition and synthesis models (you can do this later in settings).
onboarding.doneHint: Press the quick-command hotkey or say “Vivi” to start. Settings are in the bottom-left corner.

perm.linuxNote: On Linux permissions are system-level. For mouse control on Wayland install ydotool; X11 works out of the box.

proxy.title: Proxy for Claude and the internet
proxy.hint: Applies to Claude Code (HTTPS_PROXY), the embedded browser engine and voice model downloads.
proxy.passwordSaved: Password saved in the secure store
proxy.bridgeNote: For SOCKS5 and authenticated proxies Vivi runs a local HTTP bridge (127.0.0.1): Claude Code only speaks HTTP proxies, and the password stays out of the process environment.
proxy.caCertHint: Needed when the proxy re-signs TLS certificates (corporate MITM).

voice.testTtsDefault: Hi! I'm Vivi. The voice works.
voice.silenceHint: How much silence ends a command
voice.wakeWordHint: Always-on listening runs offline. The quick-command hotkey always works.
voice.modelsHint: Models are downloaded from GitHub (k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx) through the configured proxy and stored locally.
voice.cloudHint: Optional: OpenAI for recognition and synthesis (needs a key, traffic goes through the proxy).
